title: Split Media R2 Bucket into Products and CMS Buckets
context: Currently, all static assets (product images and CMS media) are stored in a single Cloudflare R2 bucket (MEDIA_R2). This complicates lifecycle rules (e.g., pruning old CMS images while keeping product images indefinitely), blurs cost tracking, and poses a theoretical security risk if IAM access is provisioned for third-party CMS tools.
decision: We will separate the monolithic MEDIA_R2 bucket into two distinct buckets: PRODUCTS_R2 and CMS_R2. The application will route read requests dynamically based on URL prefixes, and write operations will target the respective bucket bindings.

positive: Independent lifecycle rules (e.g. 30-day deletion for draft CMS images).
Granular cost accounting for Marketing vs. Inventory operations.
negative: Requires explicit routing logic in the shared media router.

author: Technical Architect
